Usage: astryx gap-report [options] [component]

Report a missing component or feature to the package that owns it

Arguments:
  component                    Component or design-system area the gap is about, up to 120 characters. Required unless --list-categories is set.

Options:
  --category <category>        Gap category (run --list-categories for values). Required unless --list-categories is set.
  --reason <reason>            What capability was missing or difficult, up to 2000 characters. Required unless --list-categories is set.
  --additional-context <text>  Optional additional context, up to 8000 characters
  --package <pkg>              Package that owns the gap: @astryxdesign/core or a loaded integration. Overrides automatic routing, which picks the integration whose component replaces the named Core component, else the one package that provides it, else Core; needed when more than one package provides the component
  --confirm-public             Allow public delivery: public handlers run, and a GitHub issues URL gets an issue filed with your gh login
  --to <package>               Send the report only to this loaded integration's issues URL, as the person chose; the destinations the output lists are the choices
  --list-categories            List valid report categories, and the destinations when there is more than one, without filing; the component and the other gap-report options are refused with ERR_INVALID_ARGUMENT
  -h, --help                   display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  filed, routed-only, confirmation required, skipped, or categories listed
  1  failed or partial delivery, invalid input, or ambiguous routing

Examples:
  # List categories
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 gap-report --list-categories
  # Prepare a report (nothing public happens without --confirm-public)
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 gap-report Button --category missing_variant --reason 'Need a compact size'
  # File where the person chose
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 gap-report Button --category missing_variant --reason 'Need a compact size' --to @acme/widgets

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/gap-report
